Château de Beaucastel

Château de Beaucastel Blanc

WhiteChâteauneuf-du-PapeAOC Châteauneuf-du-Pape

White Châteauneuf-du-Pape from Château de Beaucastel, dominated by Roussanne, broad and with remarkable ageing potential.

The Château de Beaucastel white is one of the most highly regarded white Châteauneuf-du-Papes. The Perrin family estate, in Courthézon at the northern end of the appellation, has farmed its vines without synthetic chemicals for decades and keeps all the traditionally authorised varieties planted.

Unlike many whites from the area, which are based on Grenache Blanc, Beaucastel’s is made mainly from Roussanne, a Rhône valley variety prized for its texture and ageing potential, completed by Grenache Blanc and other white varieties of the appellation; the proportions vary with the vintage. Part of the wine is fermented in barrel and part in tank, to balance texture and freshness.

In its youth it is floral and fruity; it may then go through a quieter phase, and over the years it develops notes of honey, wax and nuts. In some vintages the family also makes a Roussanne Vieilles Vignes from the estate’s oldest vines.

Tasting profile

Golden yellow. Aromas of white flowers, apricot, honey and notes of wax and almond. Broad, unctuous palate with freshness and a long finish.

Food pairing

Lobster, fish in sauce, poultry with truffle, soft cheeses

Serving

12-14 °C, large white wine glass
